title: Meet MAT
author: Adobe substance 3D
description:
MAT is the model of the contest "[Meet MAT: The 2017 Substance 3D Painting Contest](https://www.allegorithmic.com/contest/meet-mat-2017-substance-3d-painting-contest)" 

You can watch a [tutorial](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3hKrLhRNeII) giving you all the info you need about this contest here. 

Have fun and make MAT come to life under your brushstrokes, join the contest!
changes: Repacked as a single GLB; textures limited to 1024px; geometry compressed/quantized with gltf-transform Meshopt without simplification; PNG textures compressed with lossless WebP; default camera embedded; preview rendered with MuTracer and denoised with OIDN standard.
